title: Planned nationwide doctors’ strike scheduled for 22 December
reason: The visible Standard introduction reports that a government deal averted the planned strike; there is no evidence it was executed.
notes: A planned action/announcement is not coded as a public gathering.

title: KMPDU notice for doctors’ demonstration
reason: Advance notification is not itself an event. The actual 16 December occurrence is represented separately using the visible Standard photo caption, with crowd size unresolved.
notes: Do not use the notice alone to claim the march happened.
